_meta.notes: Service Agreement / Independent Contractor / Consulting Agreement. Distinguish from employment via control test (Dharangadhara Chemical Works v. Workmen AIR 1957 SC 264). No employer-employee relation. GST applies on service supply. TDS u/s 194J / 194C on payments.

title: Service / Independent Contractor Agreement

enum: Vests in Service Provider with license to Client

mandatory_clauses.title: Fees, Payment Terms, GST, TDS
mandatory_clauses.content: The Client shall pay the Service Provider {{fee_structure}} of INR {{fee}} within {{payment_terms_days}} days of receipt of valid invoice. GST shall be charged extra at applicable rates. TDS shall be deducted at source under Section {{tds_section}} of Income Tax Act 1961.

mandatory_clauses.title: Independent Contractor Relationship
mandatory_clauses.content: The Service Provider is engaged as an independent contractor and not as an employee, agent, partner, or joint venturer of the Client. No employer-employee relationship is created. The Service Provider is responsible for own income tax, social security, and all statutory dues. Reference: Dharangadhara Chemical Works v. Workmen AIR 1957 SC 264 (control test).

mandatory_clauses.title: Intellectual Property
mandatory_clauses.content: All IP created by the Service Provider in the course of performing the Services shall vest absolutely in the Client. The Service Provider hereby assigns all such IP including future IP to the Client and waives moral rights to the extent permitted by law. Pre-existing IP of the Service Provider remains with Service Provider, with a non-exclusive license to Client for use as embedded in the deliverables.

mandatory_clauses.title: Representations and Warranties
subclauses: Services performed with professional skill and care

mandatory_clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
mandatory_clauses.note: Typically cap at fees paid in last 12 months; exclude indirect/consequential damages; carve-out for breach of confidentiality, IP, gross negligence

mandatory_clauses.title: Schedules - Scope of Work, Fee Schedule, SLAs

prompt_context.system_role: You are drafting an Indian service / independent contractor agreement. Critical: maintain independent contractor framing - no employer-employee features. Apply control test thinking from Dharangadhara Chemical Works.
drafting_rules: Independent contractor clause MUST be prominent. Avoid features that suggest employment (no fixed hours, no leave, no PF/ESI, fees not 'salary').
IP vesting in Client is market standard for work-for-hire.
GST: Service Provider charges GST if registered (turnover > 20L; 10L special category states).
TDS: 194J at 10% for professional services; 194C at 1%/2% for contract work.
Liability cap typical: fees paid in trailing 12 months.
Carve-out from liability cap: confidentiality, IP infringement, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct.
Termination for convenience common with 15-30 day notice.
Reference Dharangadhara Chemical Works v. Workmen for control test if relationship is challenged.
prompt_context.tone: Formal commercial-legal, clear delineation from employment.

filing_checklist: Execute on stamp paper per state.
Verify Service Provider's GST registration and PAN.
Set up TDS deduction in client's accounts under correct section.
Issue Form 16A quarterly for TDS deducted.

validation_rules.check: Payment clause covers GST and TDS
